children.text: Introduction: Importance of the Internet
children.cn: 引言：网络的重要性

children.text: Opening and general impact
children.cn: 开篇及总体影响

children.text: Internet is playing an important role in our life now.
children.cn: 网络如今在我们的生活中扮演着重要的角色。
children.notes: play an important role in 在……中扮演重要角色
children.statement: 句子中的'is playing'是现在进行时，表示现阶段正在发生的状况。
children.explanation: 现在进行时可用于描述现阶段一直在持续的动态特征或角色。

children.text: It makes our daily life much easier and more convenient.
children.cn: 它让我们的日常生活更加轻松和便利。
children.notes: make + 宾语 + 形容词比较级
children.explanation: much可以用来修饰形容词比较级，表示程度深。

children.text: Body: Advantages and Disadvantages
children.cn: 正文：网络的利与弊

children.text: The advantages of the Internet
children.cn: 网络的优点

children.text: First, we can search for useful information and learn online easily.
children.cn: 首先，我们可以轻松地在网上搜索有用的信息并在线学习。
children.statement: First在句中用作副词，起到列举观点的过渡作用。
children.explanation: First是常见的列举序数词副词，用于引出第一个论点。

children.text: Also, we can chat with friends and relax by listening to music.
children.cn: 而且，我们还可以和朋友聊天并通过听音乐来放松。
children.notes: by doing sth. 通过做某事
children.statement: listening 在句中用作动名词，因为介词 by 后面接动名词。
children.explanation: 介词后接动词时，必须使用动名词形式 (-ing)。

children.text: The disadvantages of the Internet
children.cn: 网络的缺点

children.text: However, the Internet has some bad effects too.
children.cn: 然而，网络也有一些不良影响。
children.statement: However是副词，表示转折，通常用逗号隔开。
children.explanation: However作为副词表示转折，常用于句首或句中，并加逗号。

children.text: Some students spend too much time on computer games and ignore their studies.
children.cn: 一些学生花太多时间在电脑游戏上，从而忽视了学业。
children.notes: spend time on sth. 在某事上花时间
children.statement: too much 修饰不可数名词 time。
children.explanation: too much 修饰不可数名词，too many 修饰可数名词复数。

children.text: What is worse, looking at screens for a long time hurts their eyes.
children.cn: 更糟糕的是，长时间看屏幕会伤害他们的眼睛。
children.notes: what is worse 更糟糕的是
children.statement: 句子的主语是 looking at screens for a long time，为动名词短语作主语。
children.explanation: 动名词短语作主语，谓语动词用单数 hurts。

children.text: Ending: Hopes and Suggestions
children.cn: 结尾：希望与建议

children.text: Call to action and conclusion
children.cn: 呼吁与总结

children.text: In short, I hope all of us can use the Internet wisely and properly.
children.cn: 总之，我希望我们大家都能明智且恰当地使用网络。
children.statement: In short 用于概括总结全文观点。
children.explanation: In short 是常见的总结性过渡短语，意为“总之”。

children.text: Let us make it a helpful tool rather than a bad master.
children.cn: 让我们把它变成一个有益的工具，而不是糟糕的主人。
children.statement: rather than 后面接 bad master，构成并列对比关系。
children.explanation: rather than 意为“而不是”，连接平行并列结构。

children.text: Introduction: Indispensable Role
children.cn: 引言：不可或缺的作用

children.text: The pre-given opening and expansion
children.cn: 预设首句及拓展阐述

children.text: Internet is playing an important role in our life now.
children.cn: 网络如今在我们的生活中扮演着重要的角色。
children.notes: 严格保留题目预给出的开头句。
children.statement: 本句是题目给出的固定首句，必须与基础版保持完全一致。
children.explanation: 题目给定首句不得作任何改动或润色，必须原样保留。

children.text: Not only has it transformed the way we communicate, but it has also opened up a whole new world of knowledge.
children.cn: 它不仅改变了我们交流的方式，而且为我们开启了一个全新的知识世界。
children.notes: not only... but also... 倒装句型
children.statement: 句首使用 Not only 时，句子采用了部分倒装结构（has it transformed）。
children.explanation: 否定词或半否定词如 Not only 放在句首时，主句要用部分倒装语序。

children.text: Body: A Double-Edged Sword
children.cn: 正文：一把双刃剑

children.text: Tremendous benefits
children.cn: 显著的益处
children.keywords: on the one hand, learning, broaden

children.text: On the one hand, the web serves as an endless library where we can instantly access learning materials and broaden our horizons.
children.cn: 一方面，网络就像一座无尽的图书馆，我们可以在那里即时获取学习资料并开阔视野。
children.notes: where 引导定语从句修饰 library
children.statement: 句中 where 引导的是定语从句，并在从句中作地点状语。
children.explanation: where 先行词是 library，在从句中表示地点。
children.keywords: on the one hand, library, broaden
children.highlight: On the one hand, where, and

children.text: Hidden hazards and drawbacks
children.cn: 潜在的隐患与弊端
children.keywords: on the other hand, addicted, damage

children.text: On the other hand, it is a double-edged sword that brings serious challenges.
children.cn: 另一方面，它也是一把双刃剑，带来了严重的挑战。
children.statement: that 引导限制性定语从句修饰 sword。
children.explanation: that 替代先行词 sword，在定语从句中作主语。
children.keywords: on the other hand, double-edged sword, challenges

children.text: If teenagers become addicted to online video games, they will inevitably waste valuable time and damage both their eyesight and academic performance.
children.cn: 如果青少年沉迷于网络游戏，他们势必会浪费宝贵的时间，并损害视力和学业成绩。
children.notes: become addicted to 沉迷于；both...and... 既……又……
children.statement: If 引导条件状语从句，从句使用一般现在时，主句使用一般将来时（主将从现）。
children.explanation: 在 if 引导的真实条件状语从句中遵循“主将从现”原则。

children.text: Ending: Vision and Advice
children.cn: 结尾：愿景与呼吁

children.text: Sincere hope for the future
children.cn: 对未来的真切期许

children.text: Therefore, I sincerely hope that every student will develop strong self-discipline when surfing the Internet.
children.cn: 因此，我真诚地希望每一位同学在网上冲浪时都能养成较强的自律意识。
children.notes: when surfing the Internet 是状语从句的省略形式
children.statement: when surfing the Internet 省略了主语 they 和 be 动词 are。
children.explanation: 当状语从句主语与主句主语一致且含有 be 动词时，主语和 be 动词常可省略。

children.text: Only by doing so can we truly enjoy its convenience and create a brighter future.
children.cn: 唯有如此，我们才能真正享受其便利，并创造更美好的未来。
children.notes: only + 介词短语放句首的部分倒装
children.statement: Only by doing so 放在句首时，后面跟了部分倒装句 can we truly enjoy。
children.explanation: “Only + 状语”置于句首时，主句要采用部分倒装语序。
children.keywords: only by, truly enjoy, brighter future
